---
title: "Alternative case definitions (exhaustive search)"
output: html_document
---

Reproduces **Table 5** (aged 14 and over) and **Table S5** (children under 14, South
Sudan). Every combination of signs/symptoms is evaluated as "acute jaundice and at
least one" or "at least two" of the listed symptoms.

**Selection rule.** Among informative definitions (sensitivity + specificity > 1)
whose sensitivity and specificity both exceed a threshold, report the one with the
highest specificity, breaking ties by sensitivity and then by fewest symptoms. The
thresholds below are the ones used for the manuscript. Without a threshold, the
highest-specificity informative definition is a single rare symptom such as itch,
with about 4% sensitivity.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
source(here("R", "data.R"))
source(here("R", "metrics.R"))
source(here("R", "combos.R"))

populations <- list(
  `South Sudan` = list(dat = load_ssd(binary = TRUE), symptoms = SSD_SYMPTOMS),
  `South Sudan children` = list(dat = load_ssd(children = TRUE, binary = TRUE), symptoms = SSD_SYMPTOMS),
  Bangladesh = list(dat = load_bd(binary = TRUE), symptoms = BD_SYMPTOMS)
)

# Sensitivity/specificity thresholds used when selecting definitions (R/combos.R)
thresholds <- filter(SELECTION_THRESHOLDS, population != "Combined")
thresholds
```

```{r search}
results <- thresholds %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(all_defs = list(evaluate_case_defs(populations[[population]]$dat,
                                            populations[[population]]$symptoms, min_k)),
         n_defs = nrow(all_defs),
         n_informative = sum(all_defs$informative)) %>%
  ungroup()

results %>% select(population, min_k, n_defs, n_informative)
```

## Table 5 and Table S5

```{r selected}
selected <- results %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(best = list(format_selected(add_wilson_ci(select_case_defs(all_defs, threshold))))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(population, min_k, threshold, best) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(best) %>%
  as.data.frame()
selected
```

## Sensitivity/specificity of all informative definitions

```{r plot, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}
results %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(all_defs = list(filter(all_defs, informative))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(all_defs) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(specificity, sensitivity)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(paste("at least", min_k) ~ population) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
